import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_97/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_97/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_97/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_97/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_97/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_97/training_5.csv",
]

# Read all source files into dataframes with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all dataframes (UNION operation)
df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Add the 'Year' column as float: Year = mp_year + (mp_month - 1)/12
df['Year'] = df['mp_year'] + (df['mp_month'] - 1) / 12

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
df = df.astype({
    'adm0_name': 'string',
    'adm1_name': 'string',
    'mkt_name': 'string',
    'cm_name': 'string',
    'cur_name': 'string',
    'pt_name': 'string',
    'um_id': 'int64',
    'um_name': 'string',
    'mp_month': 'int64',
    'mp_year': 'int64',
    'mp_price': 'float64',
    'Year': 'float64'
})

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['adm0_name', 'adm1_name', 'mkt_name', 'cm_name', 'cur_name', 'pt_name',
                  'um_id', 'um_name', 'mp_month', 'mp_year', 'mp_price', 'Year']
df = df[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_97/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
